topic: Two emissions numbers, one appendix — Thirst tease

drafts.text: Google's own report holds two numbers for 2024: 3.1M tCO2e market-based, 11.3M location-based. Only one travels forward. The other stays in the appendix, quietly compounding. The archive doesn't forget in the long run. Thirst opens that appendix. Queued at the diner. https://data-snack.com
